baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 as a celestial body and word 3 as vertical, rapid motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bright body that first rises into view traverses open space and then drops or sets, making disappearance a phase of a visible trajectory rather than proof of extinction.

activation_trace.role: The rising celestial body supplies the oath's visible moving subject.
A plunge from height gives the subject a downward terminal phase.
Swift travel makes the fall a trajectory rather than a static location.

changed_reading.before: An oath by a star when it sets.
changed_reading.after: An oath by a rising celestial body at the charged phase when its swift visible course turns into descent and disappearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The polarity between the appearing sense of word 1 and the falling sense of word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction joins emergence and recession: what comes forth as a conspicuous marker is invoked precisely when it reverses direction or leaves visibility.

activation_trace.role: General emergence into view supplies the first half of an appearance-disappearance cycle.
Clearing cloud or ended rain makes visibility contingent on a changing cover.
Falling supplies the reversal by which the newly visible marker recedes.

changed_reading.before: The verse names one astronomical event.
changed_reading.after: The verse compresses a reversible visibility process: a marker emerges, becomes legible, and is caught at its withdrawal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can denote stemless ground vegetation; word 3 can denote collapse from an elevated state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A low, unsupported shoot emerges from earth and then droops or falls, turning the same syntax into a terrestrial life-cycle image alongside the celestial one.

activation_trace.role: Stemless ground growth supplies a terrestrial subject that rises without a trunk.
Downward collapse supplies the shoot's drooping or return toward earth.

changed_reading.before: Only a star is falling.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting terrestrial image shows emergent, unsupported life bending back toward the ground.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can name star-reading or deliberative planning; word 3 can name inclination and idle false speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: An act of reading signs or thinking through a plan can lose altitude when self-inclination captures it, with the resulting account liable to become vanity rather than guidance.

activation_trace.role: Reading stars and deliberating over a plan supplies an interpretive activity.
Self-inclination supplies the force that bends interpretation toward appetite.
Idle false speech supplies a possible verbal product of that captured reading.

changed_reading.before: The falling is wholly physical.
changed_reading.after: The fall can also be epistemic: sign-reading or planning tips into appetite and then into empty assertion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can denote a source or mine; word 3 can denote casting an object and rapid passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hidden reservoir sends a discrete product outward and downward; the focus image can therefore describe transmission from source to recipient as well as a body's fall.

activation_trace.role: A mine or issuing source supplies the concealed point of origin.
Casting an object from above supplies an outbound directional act.
Rapid travel carries the dispatched product across the interval.

changed_reading.before: A luminous object simply descends.
changed_reading.after: A source releases an output that travels swiftly downward, a transmission image held beside the astronomical one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately denied loss and corruption of the accompanying figure detach downward motion from misdirection. The visible marker may descend while its orienting relation remains preserved.

activation_trace.role: A conspicuous marker or clear road makes the opening body capable of orientation.
Physical descent poses the apparent risk of disappearance or loss.
The denied image of something lost blocks an equation between descent and disappearance from guidance.
Preservation through accompaniment turns the moving marker into a relational guide.
The denied darkness of error blocks a moral reading of every downward motion.

structural_cues: The two coordinated negations follow the oath immediately and govern loss and corrupt direction, not motion itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a falling marker, companionship, and explicit denials of loss and error; I infer that descent is being distinguished from disorientation. The live alternative is a literal oath followed by an unrelated character defense.

changed_reading.before: The star's descent suggests vanishing or loss.
changed_reading.after: The orienting marker can descend without being lost: lowered position and failed guidance are explicitly separable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root for falling returns as self-inclination inside a negated speech clause and is followed by hidden sourced communication. The sequence reclassifies the valid descent as transmission while excluding appetite as its verbal source.

activation_trace.role: Vertical descent supplies the opening motion that requires semantic classification.
Articulated speech supplies the human output whose source is tested.
Self-inclination is explicitly negated as the force generating that speech.
Knowledge imparted secretly supplies the alternative source of the utterance.
Speed in communication aligns revelation with the opening's swift transit.

structural_cues: The repeated root links 53:1 and 53:3, while the negation and exclusive construction in 53:3-4 oppose appetite to revelation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root echo, negated appetite, and secret rapid communication; I infer that the echo sorts downward transmission from downward capture by desire. The astronomical and epistemic readings can still coexist.

changed_reading.before: The oath concerns a physical fall alone.
changed_reading.after: The opening fall becomes a discriminator: true speech descends from a hidden source but does not fall under the speaker's appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated hidden communication and a later single descent give the source-dispatch baseline units and stages: origin, swift sending, one arrival, and witnessed reception.

activation_trace.role: An issuing mine or source supplies the dispatch origin.
Casting from above supplies the directed send.
Inscription gives the dispatched content a durable, articulated form.
The repeated hidden imparting marks source-to-recipient transfer.
One discrete descent supplies unitization rather than undifferentiated downward flow.

structural_cues: Communication verbs are doubled in 53:4 and 53:10, then a singular descent event is counted in 53:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source, casting, repeated communication, and one descent; I infer a staged transmission path. A live alternative treats every descent term as an independent event with no unitizing link to the oath.

changed_reading.before: A source releases an unspecified object downward.
changed_reading.after: The opening can image a discrete communicated unit sent rapidly from a concealed source and arriving in a witnessed descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later spatial sequence supplies a track from remote horizon through downward suspension and nearness to measured range; the eye neither veers nor overruns it. The opening fall becomes a calibrated approach to perception, not an uncontrolled plunge.

activation_trace.role: A projecting visible marker supplies a target that can be tracked and calibrated.
Swift vertical travel supplies the moving path.
A distant horizon supplies the path's remote coordinate.
Approach converts remote motion into increasing perceptual proximity.
Suspension or descent from above gives the approach its vertical geometry.
Measuring one thing by another supplies a bounded range rather than vague closeness.
The denied tiring or lateral drift of sight preserves the track.
Direct eyesight supplies the receiving instrument for the approaching marker.
The denied crossing of a limit prevents perceptual overshoot.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from highest horizon to approach, downward suspension, measured nearness, and finally two coordinated denials governing sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered spatial coordinates and disciplined vision; I infer that they retrospectively trace the opening body's path into reliable perception. The alternative is that the opening setting and later encounter have no shared geometry.

changed_reading.before: The star falls away from the observer.
changed_reading.after: The marker descends into a measured perceptual range, while reliable sight holds the line without drift or excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory makes the marker visible when cloud cover clears; later covering surrounds a boundary object while sight remains sound and signs are seen. Visibility is thus regulated by covering and uncovering, not equated with truth and falsehood.

activation_trace.role: Clearing cloud or ended rain supplies an aperture through which the marker appears.
Emergence into view supplies the disclosed phase.
A cover laid over an object supplies the concealed phase without erasing the object.
Intact eyesight keeps perception accountable across changing cover.
An outward sign supplies what becomes legible during the disclosed phase.

structural_cues: Covering in 53:16 is followed by disciplined sight and seeing signs in 53:17-18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clearing, covering, sight, and signs; I infer a controlled visibility cycle that maps back to the appearing-then-falling marker. The live alternative treats the cover as specific to the later scene only.

changed_reading.before: Setting means the marker ceases to matter once unseen.
changed_reading.after: The marker's recession marks a disclosure boundary: cover changes access to the sign without deciding its reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later chain shows labels elevated into objects, followed without compelling warrant, under conjecture and self-inclination, despite available guidance. It activates the baseline in which sign-reading descends into desire-generated assertion.

activation_trace.role: Reading stars or deliberating over a plan supplies the interpretive practice under test.
Inclination supplies the internal force that can capture interpretation.
Compelling proof supplies the absent constraint on those labels.
Tracking trace after trace supplies the mechanism of uncritical interpretive pursuit.
Uncertain supposition supplies the weak evidential state being followed.
The selves' inclination explicitly supplies the downward pull on judgment.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the available counterforce.

structural_cues: 53:23 contrasts inherited naming, absent authority, following conjecture and desire, and arriving guidance in one causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-reading, labels, absent proof, pursuit, conjecture, desire, and guidance; I infer a failure mode in which interpretation falls because appetite chooses its labels. The literal celestial oath remains live beside this warning.

changed_reading.before: The planning sense of word 1 and desire sense of word 3 are only lexical curiosities.
changed_reading.after: They form an epistemic mechanism: reading a sign can fall into inherited naming when conjecture follows what the self wants rather than warranted guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actions and striving leave concealment, become visible, and receive complete recompense. The opening emergence-fall cycle can therefore model an act entering manifestation and proceeding to consequence rather than vanishing after performance.

activation_trace.role: Coming forth into view supplies the act's transition from latent intention to manifest event.
Rapid onward travel supplies movement from performance toward outcome.
Deliberate action supplies the human item entering the consequence path.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the causal endpoint.
Directed movement toward a goal supplies the effort whose trajectory is tracked.
Making something visible supplies disclosure of previously completed striving.
Completion without deficiency ensures that the trajectory is not lost before its result.

structural_cues: 53:31 connects deeds to recompense; 53:39-41 then orders striving, its being shown, and full payment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, directed motion, action, disclosure, and full recompense; I infer that the opening trajectory can serve as a compact model of an act becoming a record. An alternative keeps the cosmic and accounting sequences independent.

changed_reading.before: What falls out of sight has completed its significance.
changed_reading.after: What emerges and passes onward may become an inspectable record whose consequence is fully returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation from earth, death and life, a generative drop, and another arising turn the stemless plant baseline into a full cycle: hidden material rises into form, bends into mortality, and is followed by renewed emergence.

activation_trace.role: Stemless growth supplies a low terrestrial figure of created emergence.
Collapse toward a lower level supplies mortality or return.
Soft productive earth supplies the material field from which growth can emerge.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the first creation phase.
Loss of vitality supplies the downward interruption in the cycle.
Earth revived through rain and growth reconnects life to the vegetation image.
A generative drop supplies a compact hidden beginning.
Rising again supplies the counter-motion after falling and death.

structural_cues: Origin from earth in 53:32 is followed by paired death and life, a generative drop, and another arising in 53:44-47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terrestrial growth, created origin, death, life, a drop, and renewed rising; I infer a cyclic arrow from emergence through fall to re-emergence. A linear celestial setting remains equally live.

changed_reading.before: The ground-plant reading ends in a single collapse.
changed_reading.after: The low plant becomes a creation-cycle figure: emergence from hidden earth, mortal descent, and another rising.

context_deltas.mechanism: Striving is shown, fully answered, and brought to an ultimate endpoint. This gives the opening fall a telos: rapid descent is arrival at a limit under governance, not random loss of altitude.

activation_trace.role: Fast directed travel supplies motion capable of reaching a terminus.
Purposeful movement supplies a trajectory governed by an aim.
Disclosure of the striving supplies arrival into inspectability.
Full completion supplies closure without remainder.
Governance and mastery supply the owner of the destination.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the explicit terminus.

structural_cues: 53:39-42 is a directed chain: effort, disclosure, full recompense, then endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful travel and an explicit governed endpoint; I infer that the opening descent may be teleological rather than merely gravitational. The alternative is ordinary astronomical setting with no endpoint analogy.

changed_reading.before: Falling is an uncontrolled loss of height.
changed_reading.after: The descending motion can be a directed completion, reaching the limit to which every trajectory is returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later specifically named celestial object is placed under lordship. The opening marker can remain magnificent enough for an oath while being stripped of autonomous agency or ultimacy.

activation_trace.role: The celestial body supplies the broad class of luminous oath-object.
Its status as a prominent marker explains its orienting force without granting it mastery.
Lordship and ownership place the later named object inside governance.
A specifically transferred proper name narrows the generic celestial class to a particular named object.

structural_cues: 53:49 predicates lordship over a specifically named object after the opening oath by the generic celestial marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generic celestial oath-object and later lordship over a named one; I infer deliberate decentering of celestial agency. The alternative is that the later name has no backward effect on the oath.

changed_reading.before: The star's magnificence can make it seem like an autonomous power.
changed_reading.after: The star is an eminent but governed marker: its descent displays contingency rather than divine autonomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's intransitive falling root returns in a causative overthrow beside reversal and total covering. A celestial descent becomes a template for elevated collective orders being inverted, cast down, and erased from view.

activation_trace.role: A body's plunge from height supplies the opening downfall pattern.
Casting something from above supplies the causative potential later made explicit.
Falling into destruction supplies the historical consequence of the pattern.
Turning a thing away from its orientation supplies inversion before the cast-down motion.
The repeated root now supplies an agentive casting down of the overturned object.
An all-enveloping cover supplies the final removal from visibility.

structural_cues: Destruction in 53:50-52 is followed by an overturned object, the repeated falling root in causative form, and total covering in 53:53-54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, inversion, the exact falling root, and covering; I infer that the historical overthrow activates a social-political scale inside the opening fall. The literal star remains the primary concrete carrier.

changed_reading.before: The fall concerns one celestial body's nightly course.
changed_reading.after: The celestial fall also becomes a scale model of reversal: what stands high can be turned over, cast down, and covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning wakes attention as the event draws rapidly near and cannot be uncovered by another; raised-headed heedlessness is then reversed into bowed worship. The opening downward trajectory becomes the posture demanded at the close.

activation_trace.role: Descent from height supplies the opening downward vector.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A celestial descent that guarantees orientation.** ن ج م B001 supplies the rising star, while ه و ي B002 supplies falling or plunging. The oath's rise/fall tension is sharpened by the later upper-horizon descent (53:7-10) and the cast-down city (53:53). I supply the abductive arrow that a reliably moving celestial marker can attest a reliable message; the ayah reads as an oath by ordered descent rather than by a static object.
2. **A visible marker entering concealment.** ن ج م B006 treats the star as a projecting marker, and ه و ي B002 makes its disappearance a downward loss from view. In light of the repeated seeing/covering sequence (53:11-18), I infer that the marker's setting models evidence that passes across the threshold of visibility without becoming false; the oath anticipates the surah's distinction between absence from sight and error.
3. **Emergence and fall held together.** ن ج م B002 is anything rising into view, whereas ه و ي B002 is falling. The compact reversal creates a full trajectory. I infer that the oath selects a phenomenon whose emergence already contains its descent, so the ayah reads as a miniature of revelation's arrival and history's coming termination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:49 returns to a specifically named star under lordship, sharpening the oath-object as governed sign rather than autonomous power. More surprisingly, 53:53 reuses ه و ي B002 for a city cast down, forcing ordered celestial descent and punitive social fall to remain distinct.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Appearance completed by descent.** `ن ج م B002` supplies the variant image of a thing rising into view, while `ه و ي B002` supplies falling or dropping into depth. Their adjacency makes the fixed ayah a compact trajectory, not a static celestial picture. The packet gives emergence and fall; I infer the arrow emergence -> descent -> delivery from the following revelation and teaching sequence in 53:4-6. The star can therefore read as a visible marker whose downward motion models transmission rather than simple disappearance.

2. **A controlled fall distinguished from caprice.** The same fixed `هَوَىٰ` also carries `ه و ي B004`, desire and inclination of the self, because 53:3 repeats the root in `ٱلْهَوَىٰ` and immediately denies it as the source of speech. The packet supplies the root echo and the denial; I infer that the echo deliberately tests one descent against the other. The oath consequently reads as an anti-caprice image: what descends in the opening is subsequently classified as taught revelation, not an uncontrolled inclination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:3 supplied the decisive `ه و ي` root echo, while 53:4-6 corrected “fall” into controlled revelation, teaching, and alignment rather than caprice.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği yukarıdan aşağı düşmedir; derin düşme yeri, art arda düşme, düşürme ve ölüm bunun açık uzantılarıdır. Bununla birlikte bir kaynak aynı hareket adını inişin yanında yükseliş yönündeki gidiş için de kullandığından kol yalnız aşağı düşüşle sınırlandırılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın düşme anlamı, derin çukur adlarından, art arda düşme kuruluşundan ve düşürme ya da ölüm uzantılarından ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Temel olarak bir şeyin yukarıdan aşağı düşmesini, aşağı yönlü gidişi ve art arda düşüşü anlatır; derin düşme yeri, dibi erişilmez çukur, ateş azabının adı, düşürme ve düşüş imgesiyle ölüm de bu kola bağlıdır. Bir kaynak yönlü gidişi yükselme için de kullanır; başka bir kullanım ölen kişinin annesini evlat acısı çekmiş olarak niteler.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin veya kuşun yukarıdan aşağı düşmesi ve aşağı yönlü ilerlemesi.
Yönlü gidişin bir kaynakta inişin yanında yükseliş için de kullanılması.
Derin çukurun, düşme yerinin ve dibi erişilmez uçurumun adlandırılması; ayrıca ateş azabının adı olması.
Bir şeyi yukarıdan düşürme, kişinin ölmesi ve insanların bir çukura art arda düşmesi.
Ölen kişinin annesinin evlat acısı çekmiş olarak nitelenmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek yüksekten aşağı düşmedir ve derin düşme yerleri, düşürme, art arda düşme ile ölüm bu çekirdeğe bağlanır. Toplu ifade ayrıca yönlü gidişin yükselme kullanımını ve ölümün anne üzerindeki yas sonucunu da kaydeder.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الهوي في السير إذا مضى (sihah)؛ المهاواة شدة السير (sihah)؛ الهوي في السير إذا مضى (tahdhib)؛ الهوي السريع إلى أسفل والهوي السريع إلى فوق (tahdhib)؛ هوت العقاب إذا انقضت (tahdhib)؛ هوت الناقة تهوي إذا عدت عدوا أرفع العدو (tahdhib)؛ الهواهي ضروب من السير (tahdhib)؛ الهوي ذهاب في انحدار والهوي ذهاب في ارتفاع (mufradat)؛ الهوي ذهاب في انحدار والهوى في الارتفاع (maqayis)؛ شدة السير لما في ذلك من الترامي بالأبدان عند السير (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi biçimi doğrudan karşılıklı inatlaşma ve çekişme olarak açıklar; her tarafın tartışmada ötekinin yönelişine takılması bu karşılıklılığın gerekçesi olarak verilir. Geçici çerçeve bu yalın biçim anlamını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekişmenin karşılıklı ve ısrarlı olması esastır; hızlı yol alma, tek kişinin içsel isteği veya genel düşmanlık bu kola girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin karşılıklı inatlaşma ve çekişme anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yol alma kuruluşundan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın bir anlaşmazlıkta birbirinin yönelişine takılarak karşılıklı ve ısrarlı biçimde çekişmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: İki tarafın bir anlaşmazlıkta karşılıklı biçimde inatlaşması ve çekişmeyi sürdürmesi.
Karşılıklılığın, her tarafın ötekinin yönelişine takılmasıyla açıklanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yalın biçimi karşılıklı inatlaşma ve çekişme olarak verir; toplu ifade bu sürekliliği tarafların birbirinin yönelişine takılmasıyla açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki tarafın birbirine bağlı biçimde sürdürdüğü ısrarlı anlaşmazlığın yalın biçim karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflılığı, inadı, anlaşmazlığı ve çekişmenin sürdürülmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın bir anlaşmazlığı karşılıklı ısrarla sürdürdüğü bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekişmenin karşılıklı, inatçı ve devam eden niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tarafların birbirinin yönelişine takılması ve karşılıklı ısrar bu kolda kurucu özelliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşılıklılık ya da belirli bir inat gerekmeden genel kavga ve tartışma komşuda yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanlar arasındaki sözlü veya davranışsal anlaşmazlık ve çekişmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol iki tarafın birbirine bağlı biçimde inatlaşmasını gerektirir; komşu genel çekişmeyi karşılıklılığın yapısını belirtmeden adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her iki tarafın karşılıklı yönelişi ve inatlaşması bu kola özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rakibi sözle eğip bükerek sıkıştırma biçimi komşuda ayrıca bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal tarafların bir anlaşmazlığı sözlü çekişmeyle sürdürmesini ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol karşılıklı ısrarın yapısını anlatır; komşu tartışmada rakibi sözle sıkıştırma ve sözünü eğip bükme biçimine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tarafların birbirinin yönelişine takılarak karşılıklı çekişmesi bu kolda belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşırı sertlik, tartışmada üstün gelme ve birini savunma kullanımları komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal güçlü inat ve ısrarla sürdürülen bir anlaşmazlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol karşılıklılığı öne çıkarır; komşu çekişmenin sertliğini, üstün gelmeyi ve savunma yönünü ayrıca kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; karşılıklılık, sözlü sıkıştırma ve sertlik sınırlarını gösteren üç çekişme dalı seçildi, alay ve genel düşmanlık gibi farklı çekirdekler dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المهاواة بمعنى الملاجة، وما علله المصدر بأن كل واحد يحب هوى صاحبه في المنازعة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو شدة السير المسماة مهاواة، ولا الهَوَى النفسي المفرد، ولا السقوط.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المهاواة الملاجة (sihah)؛ المهاواة فذكر أبو عمرو أنها الملاجة (maqayis)؛ أما الملاجة فلأن كل واحد منهما يحب هوى صاحبه (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi biçimi doğrudan asılsız sözler, boş konuşma ve anlamsız laf olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu söz alanını yol alış türleri, fiziksel boşluk ve yüreksiz kişi anlamlarından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Odak, söylenen şeyin asılsız veya boş oluşudur; yalnız yanlış iddia, süslü aldatma ya da hareket biçimi bu kola girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin asılsız ve boş sözler anlamını korur; aynı biçimin yol alış türleri kullanımı bu kola taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gerçek dayanağı bulunmayan asılsız sözleri, boş konuşmayı ve anlam taşımayan lafları topluca anlatır.

facets.statement: Gerçek dayanağı olmayan asılsız sözler ve uydurma anlatımlar.
Bilgi veya anlam taşımayan boş ve gereksiz konuşmalar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar biçimi asılsız sözler ve boş konuşma olarak ortaklaştırır; böylece hem gerçeklikten yoksunluğu hem de anlam ve yarar taşımayan lafı kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçek dayanağı bulunmayan veya anlam ve yarar taşımayan sözlerin yalın biçim karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Asılsızlık, boşluk ve sözün anlam ya da yarardan yoksun oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir söz yığınının hem gerçek dayanağı bulunmadığını hem de anlamlı içerik taşımadığını belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözlerin asılsız ve içeriksiz oluşunu doğal Türkçe anlatımla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gerçek dayanağı ve anlamlı içeriği bulunmayan asılsız sözleri topluca adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kanıttaki çekirdek ve kapsam bakımından anlamlı bir ayrım görünmez; iki dal aynı asılsız ve boş sözler alanında birbirinin yerine kullanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalan olmasa bile anlamsız ve yararsız boş konuşmayı kapsama bu kolda daha açıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle gerçek temeli olmayan yalan ve saçma masal niteliği komşuda daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gerçek dayanağı bulunmayan asılsız sözleri ve saçma anlatımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol asılsızlığın yanında genel boş lafı da kapsar; komşu sözün yalan ve temelsiz masal olmasını daha belirgin biçimde öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gerçek dışı sözlerin toplu adı olma bu kolda bulunur ve belirli bir söyleyiş tavrı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şişkin ve gösterişli konuşma tavrı komşunun gerekli anlatım özelliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal anlamlı içerikten yoksun, boş konuşmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol içeriğin asılsız veya boş oluşuna odaklanır; komşu buna konuşanın gösterişli ve şişkin söyleyiş biçimini ekler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tam eşdeğer dal ile yalan ve gösterişli boş konuşma sınırlarını açıklayan iki yakın dal seçildi, yalnız yanlış iddia veya süslü aldatma çekirdeği taşıyanlar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهواهي إذا فسرت بالأباطيل أو الباطل واللغو من القول.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الهواهي إذا فسرت بضروب السير، ولا الهَواء الخالي، ولا الهوهاءة بمعنى ضعف الفؤاد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهواهي الباطل واللغو من القول (sihah)؛ الهواهي الأباطيل (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, boşluk ve hava, düşme ve yönlü hareket, içsel istek, ayartılma, zaman dilimi, bedensel açılma, hızlı yol alma, karşılıklı çekişme ve asılsız sözler arasında belirgin biçimde çok anlamlıdır. Dalların bir bölümü boşalma veya yönelme imgeleriyle ilişkilense de her biri kendi biçim ve kuruluş sınırını korur.
